fusions.name: Full Creel
fusions.desc: Throws a hand mesh that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Crew's Share
fusions.desc: Hauls a full mesh in around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Haul to the Table
fusions.desc: Drags every body within 9 tiles to you in a mesh, up to 5. Each one heals you for 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Larder at the Belt
fusions.desc: Conjures a mesh larder at your belt: each kill restores 5 health, your maximum health rises by 15, your critical chance rises by 4%, and your critical hits deal 10% more damage.
